title: ID0411277-DC/Si-D/SE [MP / R3 170001599] BCB toggle not working with hotfix
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
BCB toggle not working with hotfix. Customer have tested it and it is not working. The charger is in free mode and not connected to any backend. The information they get is that it is waiting for autentication. We had the same issue when we did these test in sweden at volvo on the D400 and with the beta version. We then needed to connect the charger to a backend. What I have been told is that this is no longer a requirement. Volvo tested the BCB toggle today between
09:35-09:50  local time. Please send this directly to L3.
Root cause: Cannot be used without authentication as it's based on a transaction
Solution: Update to a later FW version
Update 11/Mar - R&D ticket created EVC3-8878
Update 17/Mar - EcoG ticket created SASW-2474
Update 25/Mar - Aligning info with R&D
Update 26/Mar - Fix only coming out after v8

additional_info.subject: ID0411277-DC/Si-D/SE [MP / R3 170001599] BCB toggle not working with hotfix CRM:00315002425
additional_info.body:
Hi Magnus, good morning.
As we already aligned, the reason why this issue is present is due to the lack of the backend to change the parameter TxStopPoint from “EnergyTransfer” to “PowerPathClosed”.
As such, we changed this value directly on the charger's config file and we will wait for news from the customer.
We also tested in the Berlin charger, with the support of Catalina, to confirm that, after a reboot the configuration is not changed.
We will wait for your feedback if this workaround worked so that, until R&D provides a definitive solution, we can give the customer what he requires.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0411277-DC/Si-D/SE [MP / R3 170001599] BCB toggle not working with hotfix CRM:00315002425
additional_info.body:
Hi Magnus, good morning.
Update on this subject, from R&D it's clear that, for now, it's impossible to use BCB toggle without backend, since t
he feature currently depends on a ongoing transaction. R&D opened a new ticket for a Bug for the fix to be implemented.
The solution has been reported to be fixed “
exactly somewhere after v8.0”
Since the answer has been provided please give me your feedback if I can close the ticket since there is nothing else I can support here. As always, I will keep you updated everytime there are new details.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
